name: Velora By Emaar
overview: Velora at The Valley Phase 2, a deluxe residential property with a limited number of townhouses with three and four bedrooms, is presented by Emaar Properties. The natural beauty of the surroundings served as inspiration for this brand-new community located in the center of Dubai. Six different townhouse styles are available at Velora, each offering a unique living experience: Oakley, Ravine, Serene, Nash, Vale, and Dale. These architectural designs, which feature undulating hills, verdant meadows, rivers, scenic valleys, and deep forests, seamlessly combine urban convenience with tranquil nature.
